images.title: The One Who Stayed
images.prompt: Stylised cinematic 3D animated film still, a fantasy cave world of soft glowing blue walls like translucent wax, lit from within. Inside a large blue cavern, an old lamp-keeper stands at the left, seen from the side and slightly behind: a tall slender simplified animated character, thin and gently stooped with age, pale mineral blue, dressed in a long pale woven robe from shoulders to floor. He has a clearly visible smooth rounded hairless head on a normal neck, the head a little bowed and turned away from the camera so no face shows; the back of the head is edged with gold lamplight. One arm is raised and his large gentle hand cups a small warm glowing lamp set in the wall just above head height, dimming it. The lamps further along the wall are already low. Far across the hall, a row of small rounded alcoves in the wall glow faintly. On a low pale shelf beside him rests an ivory game board with counters left in its hollows, unfinished.
